title: Mass shootings strike South Africa’s two largest cities

slides.headline: Mass shootings strike South Africa’s two largest cities
slides.subtitle: Multiple attacks occurred over a single weekend

slides.explanation: This death toll is the result of a single week of violence. It is a sharp and sudden increase in mass casualty events for the region.

slides.headline: Reports on the exact death toll vary
slides.explanation: While some outlets report 38 people were killed, others place the figure at 27. This discrepancy highlights how quickly information moves during unfolding crises.
We compared reports from four independent outlets to verify the event occurred. Agreement on the location and timing is solid, though the total casualty count remains contested.

slides.subtitle: Read the full breakdown on Headlinne.

caption:
South Africa is currently grappling with a surge in violence following a series of mass shootings near its two largest

cities.

The attacks took place over the weekend, leaving communities in shock.

There is some disagreement on the exact number of victims. While some reports cite 38 deaths, others count 27. We are tracking these updates as official statements come in.

It is a difficult time for the country as officials investigate the connections between these separate incidents. What more do you want to know about this story?
